title: Emphasize
summary: EMPHASIZE, verb transitive To utter or pronounce with a particular or more forcible stress of voice; as, to emphasize a word, for the purpose of rendering the sense more distinct or impressive than ot

inlines.v: EMPHASIZE, verb transitive To utter or pronounce with a particular or more forcible stress of voice; as, to emphasize a word, for the purpose of rendering the sense more distinct or impressive than other words in the sentence.
